mainEntity.name: How much does a foreclosed kitchen refresh cost compared with a full remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely, but a refresh is usually much less expensive than a full kitchen remodel. In Denver County, cabinet refinishing is often quoted in the low thousands for an average kitchen, while full kitchen replacement can quickly reach tens of thousands once cabinets, counters, plumbing, and electrical work are included.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh usually costs far less than a full remodel. Refinishing and cosmetic updates can stay in the low thousands, while full kitchen replacement can run much higher.
